events.desc:
HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan (Uttarayan + Joli)

A 15-day spiritual visit documenting Pramukh Swami Maharaj's activities in Ahmedabad, featuring celebrations of Gunatitanand Swami's diksha, Uttarayana festival with kite flying, and various assemblies addressing devotion, tilak-chandlo practice, and spiritual association.

(Multi-day report: 1999-01-01 to 1999-01-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mahelav

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mahelav from 15-23 January 1999, performing various spiritual activities including temple inaugurations, murti-pratishtha rituals, and blessings to devotees. The visit included the consecration of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Mahelav and visits to significant religious sites including the birthplace of Nirgundas Swami.

(Multi-day report: 1999-01-15 to 1999-01-23)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bochasan from 24-27 January 1999, where he addressed account keepers of Hari mandirs, offered spiritual counsel on maintaining niyams, and performed murti-pratishtha ceremony in Zarola village.

(Multi-day report: 1999-01-24 to 1999-01-27)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Badalpur from January 25-31, 1999, addressing assemblies on faith, moral education, and character. He inaugurated schools and visited historic mandirs while reflecting on Shastriji Maharaj's spiritual legacy in the region.

(Multi-day report: 1999-01-25 to 1999-01-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Badalpur

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Badalpur on 1-2 February 1999 for the inauguration anniversary of Akshar Purushottam Mandir and presided over the Suvarna Tula (gold-weighing ceremony) of Harikrishna Maharaj with approximately 3,500-4,000 devotees. He inaugurated the Pramukh Swami Computer Center and blessed the assembly despite being visibly ill from fever.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-01 to 1999-02-02)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Vallabh Vidyanagar from 2-7 February 1999, where he recuperated from illness while engaging in spiritual discourse, attending student events, and meeting with past hostel residents. During his stay, Swamishri addressed topics on divine nature, family conflicts, and the importance of spiritual education and Satsang values.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-02 to 1999-02-07)

Suvarna Tula (Gold-weighing) of Harikrishna Maharaj

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Anand for the Suvarna Tula ceremony of Harikrishna Maharaj, where devotees weighed the deity with gold as a token of devotion. The event attracted approximately 8,000 devotees and culminated with Swamishri's blessings emphasizing divine grace and devotion.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Karamsad

Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Shri Ashok Bhatt, Health Minister of Gujarat, inaugurated bronze images of Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj at Pramukh Swami Medical College in Karamsad with Vedic rites. Swamishri paid respects at the memorial of Shri H. M. Patel and engaged in darshan at the college.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Vadtal

On 10 February 1999, HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Vadtal, arriving at 6:00 pm for darshan. Swamishri prostrated before the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj and paid respects to the holy relics of Shriji Maharaj.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Nadiad

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Nadiad from 10-12 February 1999, participating in the first inauguration anniversary of the shikharbaddh mandir and launching a 24-hour Swaminarayan maha-mantra chanting program to celebrate the Bicentenary of Lord Swaminarayan's announcement of the mantra.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-10 to 1999-02-12)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj (Swamishri) visited Atladara, Vadodara for eight days from 13-20 February 1999, engaging with tribal devotees, blessing assemblies, and delivering discourses on spiritual topics including the Swaminarayan maha-mantra, student conduct, and the tilak-chandlo practice.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-13 to 1999-02-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gandhinagar and Himmatnagar on 20-21 February 1999, performing a ground breaking ceremony for the Maniben Hiralal Amin Vidya Sankul, welcoming spiritual dignitaries including His Holiness Shri Balwantsinghji Maharaj of a Sikh Sampraday, and delivering discourses on the significance of Akshardham and spiritual association.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-20 to 1999-02-21)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Himmatnagar on 21-22 February 1999, conducting evening assemblies and initiating 7-day discourses on the Shrimad Bhagwat and Shikshapatri. Swamishri addressed the importance of satsang and devoted listening to scriptural teachings.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-21 to 1999-02-22)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan at Khedbrahma

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Khedbrahma on 22-23 February 1999, addressing a mammoth tribal assembly of 8,000 devotees from 90 villages. During the visit, Swamishri distributed clothes to poor tribals, sanctified a mobile medical dispensary van, and 475 tribal natives renounced addictions.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-22 to 1999-02-23)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Himmatnagar

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Himmatnagar from 23-28 February 1999, conducting rituals and discourses on the Shrimad Bhagwat and Shikshapatri. The visit culminated in a special celebration honoring Harikrishna Maharaj with 6000 devotees in attendance.

(Multi-day report: 1999-02-23 to 1999-02-28)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

A 12-day spiritual visit by Pramukh Swami Maharaj to Sarangpur featuring assemblies, darshan, blessings, and inauguration of publications and website. The visit included murti-pratishtha rituals for BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Sabarmati (Ahmedabad).

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-01 to 1999-03-12)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan - Tajpur Mandir Groundbreaking

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed a groundbreaking ceremony for a new BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Tajpur village on 11 March 1999. Swamishri spoke about the village's historical connection to Shastriji Maharaj and blessed approximately 1000 devotees and well-wishers who attended the occasion.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Limbdi

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Limbdi on 12-13 March 1999, performing the groundbreaking ceremony for a new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir and addressing approximately 2,800 devotees about dharma and the Shikshapatri. He also visited Rangpur village and blessed devotees at multiple locations including Dhandhuka.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-12 to 1999-03-13)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Gondal

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gondal from 13-18 March 1999, performing murti-pratishtha ceremonies at a new mandir in Vachhara village and addressing devotees on satsang, addiction-free living, and moral conduct. The visit included participation in annual functions and blessings to devotees.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-13 to 1999-03-18)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bhadra

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bhadra on 18-19 March 1999, performing darshan and pradakshina at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir and visiting places sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Swamishri engaged in spiritual observances at the Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami janmasthan and other significant village locations.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-18 to 1999-03-19)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Jamnagar

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Jamnagar on 19-20 March 1999, performing arti at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir and sanctifying land for a new mandir. He also visited the village, devotee homes, and Satyanam Samadhi Mandir, distributing bicycles and a sewing machine to well-wishers.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-19 to 1999-03-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bhuj

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bhuj from 21-26 March 1999, culminating in the celebration of Shri Hari Jayanti (Lord Swaminarayan's birthday) on 22 March. The vicharan included pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, sanctification of land for a new BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, and visits to holy sites.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-21 to 1999-03-26)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Khavda, India on 24 March 1999. The visit included greeting speakers of Shrimad Bhagwat, assembly with devotees, and village visits where Swamishri blessed the assembled community.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gandhidham from 26 to 29 March 1999. The vicharan included sanctifying the land for a new mandir in Gandhidham.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-26 to 1999-03-29)

Pramukh Swami Computer Institute Inauguration

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj welcomed Gujarat Governor Sundersinh Bhandari to inaugurate the Pramukh Swami Computer Institute at Vallabh Vidyanagar, which introduced a post-graduate diploma in computer application. Swamishri emphasized the importance of dharma in his blessings to the assembly.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-29 to 1999-03-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bochasan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Bochasan from 30 March to 1 April 1999. During the visit, Swamishri celebrated Chaitra Punam festival with 8,500 devotees and inaugurated an audio cassette on the Swaminarayan mantra.

(Multi-day report: 1999-03-30 to 1999-04-01)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bharuch

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bharuch from 2-4 April 1999 for the pillar-laying ceremony of a new mandir under construction and presided over Tulsi-Tula Utsav festival attended by 8,000 devotees. Swamishri performed pujan rituals, placed the first pillar, and delivered blessings on dharma, discrimination, and faith in God's power.

(Multi-day report: 1999-04-02 to 1999-04-04)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Navsari

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Navsari from 4-8 April 1999, conducting assemblies, performing pujas and arti, and performing the groundbreaking ceremony for a new assembly hall at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir complex.

(Multi-day report: 1999-04-04 to 1999-04-08)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Surat

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted a 10-day spiritual visit to Surat from 8-17 April 1999, engaging in darshan, assemblies, discourses, and ceremonial events. The visit included a groundbreaking ceremony for a new student hostel campus and celebrations of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary.

(Multi-day report: 1999-04-08 to 1999-04-17)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sultanabad from 18-20 April 1999, performing the groundbreaking ceremony for a new BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir and inaugurating a Vigyan Prayog Shala at Navyug Vidyabhavan Trust in Surat.

(Multi-day report: 1999-04-18 to 1999-04-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Sankari

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sankari from 22-28 April 1999, conducting spiritual training camps for 350 volunteers and sadhus of children's activities and 375 volunteers of Satsang activities. Swamishri performed groundbreaking ceremonies for mandir construction and prasad gruh expansion.

(Multi-day report: 1999-04-22 to 1999-04-28)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Saputara

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Saputara on 1-2 May 1999, conducting daily pujas, blessing tribal devotees, and sanctifying land for a new BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir. A special evening assembly of 2,000 tribal devotees from the Dang district was held.

(Multi-day report: 1999-05-01 to 1999-05-02)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Tithal

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Tithal and Kosamba from May 2-7, 1999, inspecting the under-construction BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir and addressing assemblies of devotees, fishermen, and tribal youths. Swamishri honored the murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj and met with Jain sadhus in interfaith prayer.

(Multi-day report: 1999-05-02 to 1999-05-07)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Dharampur

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Dharampur, the native town of Kushal Kunvarba sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. A gathering of 7,000 tribal devotees received his darshan and blessings.

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Silvassa from May 10-15, 1999. The visit included welcome assemblies where devotees honored Swamishri with garlands.

(Multi-day report: 1999-05-10 to 1999-05-15)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from 16-31 May 1999, attending assemblies, blessing devotees, and participating in the proclamation ceremony of the Bhagwan Swaminarayan Flyover.

(Multi-day report: 1999-05-16 to 1999-05-31)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mumbai

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from June 1-15, 1999, during which he performed morning arti, engaged in darshan of deities, blessed devotees, and chanted the Swaminarayan dhun at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir.

(Multi-day report: 1999-06-01 to 1999-06-15)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Mumbai and Atladara (Vadodara) from 16-30 June 1999. Events included the 50th Pramukh Varni din celebration on 17 June with over 14,000 devotees and prayers for Kargil war martyrs on 20 June.

(Multi-day report: 1999-06-16 to 1999-06-30)

50th Pramukh Varni Celebration

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai and Atladara (Vadodara) for the 50th Pramukh Varni Celebration assembly from June 22-30, 1999. The vicharan included darshan, chariots, traditional dances, and spiritual assemblies.

(Multi-day report: 1999-06-22 to 1999-06-30)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Atladara

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Atladara (Vadodara) from June 22-30, 1999. The vicharan included pradakshina, blessings, lamp-lighting with dignitaries, and pujan of a tractor.

(Multi-day report: 1999-06-22 to 1999-06-30)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Vallabh Vidyanagar from 1-6 July 1999, engaging in conversations with students of BAPS Swaminarayan Chhatralaya and blessing devotees. The visit included interactions with ailing devotees seeking darshan and a visit to Santram College of Fine Arts.

(Multi-day report: 1999-07-01 to 1999-07-06)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Anand

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited the under construction BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Anand on 5 July 1999.

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Nadiad

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj (Swamishri) conducted a vicharan (spiritual visit) in Nadiad from July 6-9, 1999. The visit included arti performances and mandir darshan.

(Multi-day report: 1999-07-06 to 1999-07-09)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mahelav

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mahelav from 9-10 July 1999. During the vicharan, Swamishri performed daily pujas, engaged in darshan of Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj at his birthplace, blessed devotees, and participated in various spiritual activities at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir.

(Multi-day report: 1999-07-09 to 1999-07-10)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bochasan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bochasan from 13-28 July 1999, presiding over Rathyatra celebrations, assemblies, and inaugurations of new initiatives including herbal products and audio publications.

(Multi-day report: 1999-07-13 to 1999-07-28)

Silver Anniversary Celebrations, Lenasia

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Lenasia, South Africa for Silver Anniversary celebrations. The visit included tree plantation at the new mandir site, mahapuja rituals, arti, and meetings with community volunteers and dignitaries.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-01 to 1999-08-02)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Johannesburg, South Africa from 1-4 August 1999. Swamishri arrived at Johannesburg airport and engaged in spiritual activities at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-01 to 1999-08-04)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan in Gaborone

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gaborone, Botswana from 4-6 August 1999, where he met with President Festus G Mogae and the Indian High Commissioner. The visit included assemblies with dignitaries, well-wishers and devotees, and a visit to the Presidential palace.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-04 to 1999-08-06)

Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir Murti-Pratishtha

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's vicharan in Durban featured a yagna for world peace, a grand nagar yatra procession with 1,000 participants, and the consecration ceremony of Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir attended by 4,000 devotees.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-06 to 1999-08-10)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Johannesburg, South Africa from 10-13 August 1999, engaging in spiritual activities with devotees in Mayfair. The visit included chanting of Swaminarayan dhun, annkut arti, and arti performances.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-10 to 1999-08-13)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan in Lusaka

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Lusaka, Zambia from 13-15 August 1999. The visit included meetings with dignitaries including Shri Suresh Desai, Minister of Agriculture, and Shri Atri, the Indian High Commissioner.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-13 to 1999-08-15)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan to Malawi

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Lilongwe, Malawi from 15-17 August 1999. The Vice President of Malawi, Hon. Justin Malewezi, welcomed Swamishri during this spiritual visit.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-15 to 1999-08-17)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Blantyre

Mahant Swami Maharaj conducted a spiritual visit to Blantyre from August 17-19, 1999. The vicharan included blessings to the assembled devotees.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-17 to 1999-08-19)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Harare

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj (referred to as Swamishri) visited Harare, Zimbabwe from 19-21 August 1999. During the visit, Swamishri established a Yuvak Mandal in Harare and engaged with local devotees and youth.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-19 to 1999-08-21)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Nairobi

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Nairobi, Kenya from 21-31 August 1999, where he performed various rituals at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, inaugurated a new mandir under construction, and met with Kenyan dignitaries including President Daniel Arap Moi. The visit included yagna ceremonies, nagar yatra processions, and community engagement through exhibitions and cultural performances.

(Multi-day report: 1999-08-21 to 1999-08-31)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Cairo

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Cairo, Egypt on 1-2 September 1999, offering prayers at the pyramids of Giza and conducting an evening assembly of 100 devotees attended by Indian Ambassador H.E. Shivshankar Mukherjee.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-01 to 1999-09-02)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Tel Aviv

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Tel Aviv, Israel on 3-4 September 1999, celebrating Janmashtmi festival with devotee assemblies, performing arti, and engaging in inter-faith dialogue with Rabbi Aurahah Elimelah Firer. The visit included meetings with city officials and devotees, and a pilgrimage to Bethlehem.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-03 to 1999-09-04)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mombasa

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mombasa, Kenya from September 6-14, 1999. During the vicharan, Swamishri performed arti at BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir and Shiv Mandir, conducted janoi changing rituals, blessed devotees and sadhus, and was honored by city officials including Deputy Mayor Abdul Latif who presented the Key to the City.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-06 to 1999-09-14)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mwanza

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Mwanza, Tanzania from 22-26 September 1999, performing the ground-breaking ceremony (bhumi pujan) for Lake University and addressing students at Lake Primary School. The vicharan included assemblies, kirtans, pujas, and interactions with the local Satsang community.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-22 to 1999-09-26)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Kampala

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Kampala, Uganda from 26-30 September 1999, arriving at Entebbe International Airport and conducting a procession of new murtis through the streets of Kampala. The visit included murti-pratishtha rituals, nagar yatra procession, and meetings with the Indian Ambassador.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-26 to 1999-09-30)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Jinja

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Jinja, Uganda from 30 September to 1 October 1999. He performed murti-pratishtha of Hanumanji and Ganpatiji at the Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir and was welcomed by local dignitaries including the Mayor and Minister of Information.

(Multi-day report: 1999-09-30 to 1999-10-01)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Kakira

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Kakira, Uganda from October 1-3, 1999. Swamishri offered flowers at the memorial of Muljibhai Madhvani and offered prayers for peace and progress of Uganda.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-01 to 1999-10-03)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Eldoret

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Eldoret, Kenya from 3-6 October 1999, performing daily pujas and artis at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir. The visit included assemblies with sadhus and devotees, interaction with children, and visits to local Sikh Gurudwaras.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-03 to 1999-10-06)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Kisumu

A five-day spiritual visit by HH Mahant Swami Maharaj to Kisumu, Kenya featuring daily pujas, assemblies, a Fuldol festival with over 250 devotees, and a youth commitment ceremony with 120 youths pledging to give up addictions.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-06 to 1999-10-10)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Nakuru

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited Nakuru, Kenya from 10-13 October 1999, where he inaugurated and consecrated the new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir. The visit included mahapuja rituals, murti-pratishtha ceremonies, and assemblies with sadhus and devotees.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-10 to 1999-10-13)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Nairobi

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Nairobi, Kenya from October 13-21, 1999 as part of his 82-day Africa tour. During the visit, he inaugurated a new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, participated in various assemblies including kirtan-bhakti and Parents Day programs, and celebrated Diwali and Annkut with symbolic observances.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-13 to 1999-10-21)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Mumbai

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj (referred to as Swamishri) visited Mumbai from 21-23 October 1999, performing arti at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir and meeting with dignitaries including actor Amitabh Bachchan.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-21 to 1999-10-23)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Gondal

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gondal, Rajkot from October 23-30, 1999, including celebration of Sharad Punam festival and Jaga Swami's birthday. The vicharan included darshan at mandirs, pujan ceremonies, blessings to devotees and assemblies.

(Multi-day report: 1999-10-23 to 1999-10-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Junagadh

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Junagadh from 1-3 November 1999, performing patotsav mahapuja rituals and arti at Shri Swaminarayan Mandir. The vicharan included meetings with dignitaries, blessings to devotees, and visits to sacred sites associated with Aksharbrahma Gunatitanand Swami.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-01 to 1999-11-03)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Jetpur

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj (referred to as Swamishri and Pramukh Swami Maharaj) visited Jetpur on 3 November 1999. The visit included darshan at Swaminarayan Mandir, Jetpur, the historic shrine where Ramanand Swami appointed Sahajanand Swami as Head of the Sampradaya.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Gondal

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted a spiritual visit to Gondal from 3-11 November 1999, during which he blessed devotees, performed pujas and artis, observed annakut preparations, and sanctified sacred texts. Youth programs were organized throughout the visit including pledges during Navratri observance.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-03 to 1999-11-11)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bhadra

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bhadra on 11-12 November 1999. Swamishri performed pradakshina at Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami janmasthan and visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Bhadra.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-11 to 1999-11-12)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Rajkot

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj (Swamishri) visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Rajkot from 12-14 November 1999. During the visit, Swamishri performed daily puja, arti, pradakshina, and blessed numerous devotees, including one who had prostrated 8 kms to the mandir.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-12 to 1999-11-14)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Sarangpur

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur from November 15-20, 1999. The visit included darshan with devotees, arti performances, annakut offerings, and blessings at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, with November 19 marked as Prabodhini Ekadashi.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-15 to 1999-11-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Bochasan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Bochasan from 22-25 November 1999. The vicharan included arti, assemblies with devotees, and blessings from Swamishri.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-22 to 1999-11-25)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan - Murti-Pratishtha

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed murti-pratishtha rituals at the Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir in Valvod. New murtis of Lord Swaminarayan, Gunatitanand Swami, Gopalanand Swami, Hanumanji and Ganpatiji were installed.

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bhadaran on 26-27 November 1999, where he blessed devotees at the Swaminarayan Mandir, inaugurated the 'Pramukh Swami Marg' with Shri Ashok Bhatt, and reinaugurated the school.

(Multi-day report: 1999-11-26 to 1999-11-27)

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Vasna

HH Mahant Swami Maharaj visited the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Vasna (Borsad) on 27-28 November 1999. During the visit, Swamishri arrived at the mandir and toured the mandir campus.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited New York, Edison (New Jersey), and London from September 17-30, 2007, during the BAPS Centenary Year. The vicharan included murti consecrations, celebrations of Jal Jhilani Ekadashi, centenary assemblies, and various spiritual gatherings.

(Multi-day report: 2007-09-17 to 2007-09-30)
events.location: New York, Edison, London (USA and UK)

events.desc:
HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, London

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 15-day spiritual visit to London, UK from October 1-15, 2007, featuring multiple assemblies including Youth Shibir, National Sanyukta Mandal Shibir, Swaminarayan School Day, and National Kishore-Kishori Shibir with various cultural presentations, discourses and blessings.

(Multi-day report: 2007-10-01 to 2007-10-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj undertook a vicharan (spiritual visit) to Mumbai and Gondal from October 15-31, 2007. During the visit, he performed murti-pratishtha rituals, foundation-stone ceremonies, and participated in the 222nd birthday celebration of Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami.

(Multi-day report: 2007-10-15 to 2007-10-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gondal, Rajkot from November 1-15, 2007, performing murti-pratishtha rituals, presiding over Diwali mahapuja and chopda pujan ceremonies, and blessing devotees at New Year celebrations and a BAPS Centenary Year assembly. Over 20,000 devotees participated in the annakut and centenary celebrations.

(Multi-day report: 2007-11-01 to 2007-11-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur and Bochasan from November 15-30, 2007, during which several religious assemblies and rituals were conducted including BAPS Centenary celebrations, Dev Diwali observances, and murti-pratishtha ceremonies.

(Multi-day report: 2007-11-15 to 2007-11-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 17-day spiritual visit to Bochasan, Ahmedabad from 1-17 December 2007, during which he performed murti-pratishtha rituals at multiple mandirs including in Chansad, Karvan, and Kukadiya. The visit coincided with Swamishri's 87th birthday celebration on 7 December, marked by devotional assemblies and performances.

(Multi-day report: 2007-12-01 to 2007-12-17)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Ahmedabad from 18-31 December 2007. During the vicharan, Swamishri performed murti-pratishtha rituals at BAPS mandir in Jagannathpuri and experienced health challenges including fever and diarrhea, followed by cardiac monitoring.

(Multi-day report: 2007-12-18 to 2007-12-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Mumbai from January 1-14, 2008, featuring daily pujas, darshan, devotee blessings, and a murti-pratishtha ceremony for a BAPS mandir in Aashi. The visit included a successful cardiac angiography procedure during which Swamishri maintained his spiritual practices and blessed devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2008-01-01 to 2008-01-14)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from January 15-31, 2008, performing murti-pratishtha rituals and blessings at multiple BAPS mandirs in the region. He consecrated murtis at mandirs in Dabhan, Jalundh, and Vadola.

(Multi-day report: 2008-01-15 to 2008-01-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from February 1-15, 2008. On February 11, a murti of Shastriji Maharaj was consecrated at Dadar mandir with preliminary rituals by Kothari Swami and final pujan performed by Swamishri.

(Multi-day report: 2008-02-01 to 2008-02-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Mumbai from 16-29 February 2008, featuring daily religious activities including ras performances, pujan and arti ceremonies at multiple BAPS mandirs, and murti-pratishtha rituals across several locations in Tithal district.

(Multi-day report: 2008-02-16 to 2008-02-29)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Mumbai (1-9 March) and Bhavnagar (13-18 March) in 2008. During the Bhavnagar visit, Swamishri provided final darshan and blessings to Rishubha Vala of Talaja, a reformed devotee who passed away shortly after.

(Multi-day report: 2008-03-01 to 2008-03-18)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur and Saraspur from March 18-31, 2008. During the vicharan, Swamishri performed murti-pratishtha rituals for three BAPS mandirs and provided spiritual counsel to devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2008-03-18 to 2008-03-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 15-day spiritual visit to Sarangpur featured murti-pratishtha rituals at two BAPS mandirs and a 228th birthday celebration of Bhagwan Swaminarayan with discourse on Ram rajya and ekantik dharma.

(Multi-day report: 2008-04-01 to 2008-04-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Sarangpur from May 1-15, 2008, featuring the 92nd Patotsav of Sarangpur Mandir on May 10 with puja, abhishek, arti and kirtan rituals. The visit included blessings for youth trainees, spiritual guidance to a reformed devotee, and discourse on the Vachanamrut.

(Multi-day report: 2008-05-01 to 2008-05-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted a spiritual visit to Saraspur from May 16-31, 2008. During this period, he performed murti-pratishtha rituals and consecrated murtis at BAPS hari mandir in Amroli, Surat.

(Multi-day report: 2008-05-16 to 2008-05-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur from June 1-15, 2008, observing Yogi Jayanti, celebrating the 58th Pramukh Varni Din, and performing murti-pratishtha rituals for a mandir in Dhobighat.

(Multi-day report: 2008-06-01 to 2008-06-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Sarangpur, India from June 16-30, 2008. The event is documented through a photo gallery.

(Multi-day report: 2008-06-16 to 2008-06-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's vicharan in Sarangpur from 1-14 July 2008, featuring murti-pratishtha rituals for Nilkanth Varni at Bhavnagar mandir and Ghanshyam Maharaj at Sarangpur mandir, along with Rath Yatra celebrations.

(Multi-day report: 2008-07-01 to 2008-07-14)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Bochasan from July 14-31, 2008, featuring Guru Purnima celebrations with thousands of devotees and senior sadhus, followed by volunteer satsang camps.

(Multi-day report: 2008-07-14 to 2008-07-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Anand, Bochasan, and Vidyanagar from 1-18 August 2008, conducting assemblies on solar eclipse, performing murti-pratishtha rituals, and celebrating Raksha Bandhan festival with thousands of devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2008-08-01 to 2008-08-18)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Atladara in Vadodara from August 18-31, 2008. During the visit, Janmashtami celebrations were held with discourses on spiritual equanimity and faith in God, and murti-pratishtha rituals were performed for the BAPS hari mandir in Dudhvada.

(Multi-day report: 2008-08-18 to 2008-08-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Ahmedabad from September 1-14, 2008, celebrating Jal Jhilani festival on September 11 with elaborate water-themed rituals. The festival featured a procession, mahapuja, bhajans, and a remote-controlled boat display with deity installation in the assembly hall.

(Multi-day report: 2008-09-01 to 2008-09-14)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Ahmedabad from September 15 to October 1, 2008, featuring a Shastriji Maharaj Smrutiparva celebration on September 18. More than 14,500 devotees attended the memorial day observance which included bhajans, puja, and blessings from Swamishri.

(Multi-day report: 2008-09-15 to 2008-10-01)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Jamnagar from October 1-12, 2008, culminating in the foundation-stone laying ceremony for a grand Swaminarayan mandir on October 8th at age 87. The visit included welcome ceremonies, satsang assemblies, and participation from thousands of devotees and dignitaries including government officials and the former Defence Minister of India.

(Multi-day report: 2008-10-01 to 2008-10-12)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Gondal spanning three weeks, featuring major celebrations including Sharad Purnima (Gunatitanand Swami's birthday), Diwali Chopda Pujan, New Year with Annakut festival, murti pratishtha ceremonies, and concluding with Labh Pancham and decennial Rajkot mandir celebration.

(Multi-day report: 2008-10-13 to 2008-11-04)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bochasan from November 4-15, 2008, conducting spiritual programs including Dev Prabodhini Ekadashi celebrations, Dev Diwali observance with annakut, murti-pratishtha rituals for eight BAPS mandirs, and concluding with travels to Sankari.

(Multi-day report: 2008-11-04 to 2008-11-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sankari and Tithal from November 15-30, 2008, performing murti-pratishtha rituals for multiple BAPS mandirs and conducting spiritual assemblies. The vicharan included a welcome assembly with over 18,000 devotees, murti consecrations across six mandirs, and a prayer assembly following the Mumbai terrorist attacks.

(Multi-day report: 2008-11-15 to 2008-11-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Tithal and Navsari from December 6-20, 2008. During this vicharan, he celebrated his 88th birthday on December 6-7 with subdued observances due to the Mumbai terrorist attacks, and conducted satsang assemblies with discourses on spiritual wisdom.

(Multi-day report: 2008-12-06 to 2008-12-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Surat from 20-31 December 2008. On 28 December, preliminary rituals of mandir patosav and guru parampara murti pratishtha were performed, with over 25,000 devotees attending morning puja darshan on the occasion of Swamishri's 70th diksha anniversary.

(Multi-day report: 2008-12-20 to 2008-12-31)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Surat from January 1-16, 2009, presiding over multiple spiritual assemblies and events. The vicharan included celebrations of Poshi Punam, Bal Din, Yuva Din, and Uttarayan with tens of thousands of devotees in attendance.

(Multi-day report: 2009-01-01 to 2009-01-16)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Atladara, Vadodara, and Bharuch from January 16-31, 2009. During the visit, he delivered spiritual discourses, performed pratishtha rituals for multiple BAPS mandirs, and blessed devotee assemblies on topics including spiritual knowledge, satsang, and devotion to God.

(Multi-day report: 2009-01-16 to 2009-01-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's vicharan (spiritual visit) spanning Atladara (Vadodara) and New Delhi from 1-15 February 2009, featuring foundation stone laying for Shri Swaminarayan Mandir Mahuva, silver jubilee of Akshar-Purushottam Chhatralay, Suvarna Tula Mahotsav commemorating Shastriji Maharaj's 60th golden anniversary, murti-pratishtha rituals, and Children's Day celebrations.

(Multi-day report: 2009-02-01 to 2009-02-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited New Delhi from 16-28 February 2009, performing pujas, attending satsang assemblies, visiting Akshardham, and meeting with dignitaries including Nobel Peace Prize winner Rajendra Pachauri and Opposition Leader L.K. Advani. Key events included a satsang shibir, rededication of Narayan Sarovar with waters from 151 Indian rivers, and a symbolic Pushpadolotsav (Fuldol) celebration.

(Multi-day report: 2009-02-16 to 2009-02-28)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Bhavnagar and Sarangpur from March 1-13, 2009, featuring various religious ceremonies including murti-pratishtha, diksha rituals for youths, and festival celebrations. The vicharan included Annakut offerings, Children's Day celebrations, Fuldol festival, and Bhagatji Maharaj's birthday observances.

(Multi-day report: 2009-03-01 to 2009-03-13)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur from 14-31 March 2009, performing murti-pratishtha rituals for BAPS mandirs in Kakamega (Kenya), Udanch (Navsari), and Swamini Bhichari (Rajkot), while providing spiritual guidance to devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2009-03-14 to 2009-03-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted a 20-day spiritual visit to Sarangpur from 1-20 April 2009, performing murti pratishtha rituals at multiple BAPS mandirs, celebrating Shri Swaminarayan Jayanti and Hari Jayanti, and conducting a diksha ceremony for 31 parshads and 16 sadhaks.

(Multi-day report: 2009-04-01 to 2009-04-20)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from April 20-30, 2009, performing murti-pratishtha rituals, blessing devotees, and consecrating Nilkanth Varni and Guru Parampara murtis. The visit included a welcome assembly with 7,000 devotees celebrating the completion of austerities observed for Swamishri's 88th birthday.

(Multi-day report: 2009-04-20 to 2009-04-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from May 1-15, 2009. During the vicharan, he blessed devotees including film star Amitabh Bachchan, performed abhishek ceremonies, and delivered spiritual discourses on satsang and bhakti.

(Multi-day report: 2009-05-01 to 2009-05-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Mumbai spanning May 15-31, 2009, featuring multiple satsang assemblies, murti-pratishtha ceremonies, and celebrations of Yogiji Maharaj's birthday and Swamishri's 60th anniversary as BAPS president.

(Multi-day report: 2009-05-15 to 2009-05-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from 1-15 June 2009, during which two major satsang assemblies were held celebrating Children's Day (7 June) and Kishore-Kishori/Yuvak-Yuvati Day (14 June) with thousands of devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2009-06-01 to 2009-06-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mumbai from 16-26 June 2009. During the visit, a large-scale Rath Yatra was organized on 24 June with decorative palanquins carrying murtis of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Jabreshwar Maharaj, and Shri Dakshineshwar Maharaj through the streets of Dadar.

(Multi-day report: 2009-06-16 to 2009-06-26)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Bochasan from June 26 to July 15, 2009, featuring various rituals including prayers for monsoon rains, Guru Purnima celebrations with over 60,000 devotees, and murti-pratishtha rituals for BAPS hari mandir in Wellingborough, UK.

(Multi-day report: 2009-06-26 to 2009-07-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Atladara, Vadodara for three weeks from July 29 to August 18, 2009, during which various celebrations and assemblies were held including Prapti Day, Children's Day, Janmashtmi, and Indian Independence Day.

(Multi-day report: 2009-07-29 to 2009-08-18)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Ahmedabad from August 18-31, 2009, featuring satsang assemblies, discourses, and celebration of Jal Jhilani festival with remote-controlled boat rituals for Thakorji and Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

(Multi-day report: 2009-08-18 to 2009-08-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 15-day spiritual visit to Ahmedabad featured satsang assemblies, Shastriji Maharaj Memorial Day celebrations, and murti pratishtha rituals. The vicharan included traditional performances, bhajans, and discourses on the Akshar-Purushottam philosophy with attendance exceeding 18,000-19,000 devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2009-09-01 to 2009-09-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Ahmedabad from 16-30 September 2009 featured various assemblies, dramas, and rituals including murti-pratishtha of a new BAPS mandir in Vastral. Swamishri provided blessings and spiritual guidance to devotees during the vicharan.

(Multi-day report: 2009-09-16 to 2009-09-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Gondal

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gondal from September 30 to October 15, 2009. The visit included the 75th inaugural anniversary of Gondal Mandir and the 225th birthday celebration of Gunatitanand Swami with over 29,000 devotees participating.

(Multi-day report: 2009-09-30 to 2009-10-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Gondal, Rajkot

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Gondal and Rajkot from October 16-31, 2009, featuring Diwali celebrations, Annakut Festival, New Year observances, and Prabodhini Ekadashi festivities at Akshar Mandir and surrounding locations.

(Multi-day report: 2009-10-16 to 2009-10-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Bochasan from 1-15 November 2009, with a major Dev Diwali celebration on 2 November featuring a grand annakut offering, arti in three mandir shrines, and assembly programs commemorating the Bicentenary Diksha Ceremony year of Gunatitanand Swami.

(Multi-day report: 2009-11-01 to 2009-11-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Anand

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Anand from December 4-19, 2009, where he performed murti-pratishtha rituals, blessed devotees, and inspired students and youths with spiritual teachings on niyams, satsang, and true progress.

(Multi-day report: 2009-12-04 to 2009-12-19)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Mahelav from 19-28 December 2009. On 20 December, youth assemblies performed a drama and traditional dance, after which Swamishri blessed the assembly explaining the spiritual significance of the village and its mandir.

(Multi-day report: 2009-12-19 to 2009-12-28)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Spiritual visit by HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj to Nadiad, India from 28 to 31 December 2009.

(Multi-day report: 2009-12-28 to 2009-12-31)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Nadiad from January 1-6, 2010, engaging in morning pujas, darshan of Thakorji, blessing devotees and students, and addressing assemblies on faith and public service.

(Multi-day report: 2010-01-01 to 2010-01-06)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan at Madhubhan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Madhubhan from 7 to 11 January 2010. The vicharan included morning pujas, kirtans, blessings to devotees, and daily walks.

(Multi-day report: 2010-01-07 to 2010-01-11)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan at Atladara

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Atladara, Vadodara from 11-13 January 2010. The visit included darshan of deities, blessings of devotees and sadhus, pradakshina, and skit presentations.

(Multi-day report: 2010-01-11 to 2010-01-13)

Uttarayan Festival Celebration

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj presided over an Uttarayan festival evening celebration held on an open ground opposite the mandir in Vadodara. The event featured discourse on festival importance, traditional performances, youth dances, and blessing of over 17,000 devotees with mahaprasad distribution.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan - Atladara

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Atladara in Vadodara on 15 January 2010. The visit included mandir pradakshina, Guru Parampara darshan, grahan assembly, and a drama presentation.

Vasant Panchami Celebration & Shastriji Maharaj Birthday

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Atladara to celebrate Vasant Panchami and commemorate the birthday of Shastriji Maharaj. The event included sanctification of a donated ambulance and herbal care van, cultural programs, speeches by senior sadhus, and Swamishri's blessing of 16,000 devotees.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj Vicharan - Murti Pratishtha Ceremonies

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj (Swamishri) performed murti-pratishtha rituals for nine BAPS hari mandirs across multiple villages in the Vadodara region. The vicharan included morning puja, ground-breaking ceremonies, blessings for tribal and other devotees, and consecration rituals.

Parents Day Celebration Satsang Assembly

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted a satsang assembly themed on family values and parental responsibilities. The event featured a question-answer session with parents, traditional dance, drama presentation, and the inauguration of a children's publication 'Sutev-Kutev' by Swaminarayan Aksharpith.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Atladara in Vadodara, India on 1-2 February 2010. The visit featured devotional activities including skit presentations and blessings to devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2010-02-01 to 2010-02-02)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Gandhinagar from 2–14 February 2010, featuring darshan, pujas, cultural programs, and the pratishtha (consecration) rituals for a new BAPS mandir at Bavla and shilanyas (foundation stone laying) for a mandir at Himmatnagar.

(Multi-day report: 2010-02-02 to 2010-02-14)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gandhinagar from 15-25 February 2010, engaging in morning pujas, blessings of sadhus, satsang assemblies with traditional performances, and pujan of temple bricks for BAPS hari mandir in Ambavadi.

(Multi-day report: 2010-02-15 to 2010-02-25)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur from 25-28 February 2010, engaging in darshan of Thakorji, morning puja, and blessings to sadhus and devotees. The visit included gatherings at Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir and various spiritual activities.

(Multi-day report: 2010-02-25 to 2010-02-28)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan - Pushpadolotsav

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur on 1 March 2010 for the Pushpadolotsav assembly at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir. The visit included kirtan, pujan and arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, inauguration of new publications, and ceremonial shower of sanctified colored water on devotees and sadhus.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Sarangpur from March 2-6, 2010. The visit included darshan of Thakorji, morning puja, and interactions with sadhus and devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2010-03-02 to 2010-03-06)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Sarangpur from 7-9 March 2010, featuring darshan with devotees, puja, pradakshina, and meetings with senior sadhus.

(Multi-day report: 2010-03-07 to 2010-03-09)

Diksha Mahotsav - Initiation Ceremony

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj (Swamishri) presided over a Diksha Mahotsav at Sarangpur where 42 youths received parshad and bhagvati diksha (initiation). The ceremony included morning puja, ritual preparations, guru mantra initiation, and blessings for newly initiated sadhus and parshads.

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Sarangpur

Pramukh Swami Maharaj conducted spiritual activities in Sarangpur from 11-15 March 2010. The visit included murti-pratishtha rituals for BAPS mandirs at Kachhal and Palaj, blessings for students and devotees, and sanctification ceremonies for newly initiated sadhus and parshads.

(Multi-day report: 2010-03-11 to 2010-03-15)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Sarangpur featured murti-pratishtha rituals for new BAPS mandirs at Sonasan, Vadu and Dared, and the 29th patotsav celebration at Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir attended by over 3,500 devotees.

(Multi-day report: 2010-03-25 to 2010-03-31)

Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show Opening Ceremony

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj attended the opening ceremony of the Sat-Chit-Anand Water Show at Swaminarayan Akshardham on 3 April 2010. The event was inaugurated by Swamishri along with Chief Minister Narendra Modi, Scientific Adviser to the Prime Minister Dr R. Chidambaram, and Creative Director Yves Pépin.

(Multi-day report: 2010-04-03 to 2010-04-09)

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan - Murti-Pratishtha

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed murti-pratishtha rituals and pujan for BAPS mandirs in Gandhinagar Sector 6 and 26, and Vavol. Swamishri blessed devotees and participated in satsang assemblies with youth cultural performances and educational activities.

(Multi-day report: 2010-04-10 to 2010-04-11)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Gandhinagar from 12-16 April 2010. The vicharan included darshan with sadhus and devotees, skit presentations, and sanctification of a violin.

(Multi-day report: 2010-04-12 to 2010-04-16)

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Ahmedabad from 16-30 April 2010. The vicharan included daily pujas, arti, darshan of deities, blessing of devotees, skit presentations, and kirtan performances in the ochchhav bhakti tradition.

(Multi-day report: 2010-04-16 to 2010-04-30)

HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan

Pramukh Swami Maharaj's spiritual visit to Ahmedabad from 3-9 May 2010, featuring morning pujas, murti consecrations for four BAPS mandirs, devotee interactions, and cultural programs including Children's Day celebrations.

(Multi-day report: 2010-05-03 to 2010-05-09)

Symbolic Annakut

Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited Ahmedabad May 10-14, 2010, engaging in darshan with devotees, morning pujas, and performing a symbolic Annakut festival with over 425 food items before departing to Jamnagar.

(Multi-day report: 2010-05-10 to 2010-05-14)
